description: Returns a ready Google Ads Script (JavaScript) for one campaign that a person pastes into Google Ads themselves. The tool only produces text. Amounts are in the ad account's own currency, in whole units (not cents or micros).

campaign_id.description: ADS Beast id from list_campaigns, not the platform's.

new_value.description: New value for the update actions: monthly budget, target CPA or target ROAS.
